title: Your Phone Drains Your Brain Even When It's Off

scenes.text: Your phone is draining your brain right now. Even face down and silent.
Researchers at the University of Texas tested nearly eight hundred people on tasks that need full concentration.
Some had their phone on the desk. Some in a pocket or bag. Some left it in another room.
The other-room group scored clearly best. The phone-on-desk group scored worst, even though nobody touched their phone.
It made no difference whether the phone was on or off, face up or face down.
It happens because part of your brain is busy not checking it. Resisting the urge costs mental power.
So next time you need to focus, don't flip it over. Put it in another room.

description:
Your phone drains your brain power just by being nearby, even when it's off and face down.
University of Texas researchers tested nearly 800 people. Those whose phones were in another room did clearly better on concentration tasks than those with a phone on the desk.
Resisting the urge to check it uses up part of your limited mental capacity.
Where is your phone right now?
